title: Design System: Hacktoberfest Hack Day × DDUGU

display.purpose: Hero and major section statements only; Fraunces supplies the site's identity.

body.purpose: Long-form event information and explanatory copy.

label.purpose: Times, categories, route labels, code, terminal chrome and compact status only.

shadows.name: nav-ambient
shadows.purpose: Soft depth for the floating glass navigation without competing with the hero.

shadows.name: map-depth
shadows.purpose: Signature depth for the interactive campus map.

motion.name: ease-confident
motion.purpose: Fast, natural deceleration for control feedback.

motion.name: feedback-fast
motion.purpose: Button, FAQ and compact hover/focus feedback.

motion.name: layout-medium
motion.purpose: Campus illustration opacity/transform detail reveal within stable responsive dimensions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: CSS animation and transitions disabled; map detail state remains available
motion.purpose: Preserve state feedback while removing spatial tilt, drawing and pulse motion.

breakpoints.name: very-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Single-column facts and tighter timeline geometry.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Compact hero, buttons and one-column build lanes.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Collapse editorial two-column layouts and enable mobile navigation.

breakpoints.name: manifesto-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Simplify manifesto composition and hide its stamp.

breakpoints.name: wide-tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Move the four build lanes to a two-column grid.

breakpoints.name: single-column-content
breakpoints.purpose: Single-column build lanes and fluid mobile rewards type.

narrative.summary: A cinematic university open-source gathering after dark: expressive at the hero, calm and editorial through the content, tactile only where interaction is real.
rules: The photographic hero owns saturation and spectacle.
Gold is scarce and signals importance, focus or location.
Fraunces carries identity; DM Sans carries reading; DM Mono means code or metadata.
The map is the signature tactile object below the hero; informational cards stay stable.
Never imply a 24-hour event, guaranteed swag, sponsor support or registration before it is confirmed.
The floating navbar must visually recede into the hero rather than compete with it.
donts: Do not reintroduce a top marquee or decorative hero corner slogans.
Do not use the same tilt/lift interaction on every surface.
Do not turn ordinary sections into card grids when editorial composition can carry the content.
Do not use hard offset shadows as the default depth language.
